tools.title: PHQ-9 Self-Reflection Questionnaire
tools.description: A brief set of questions to help you reflect on how you've been feeling emotionally over the past two weeks.
tools.disclaimer: This questionnaire is widely used to understand patterns of low mood and emotional distress. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace speaking with a mental health professional.

questions.question: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Feeling tired or having little energy
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Poor appetite or overeating
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

questions.question: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself
questions.context: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by this?

low.title: A Moment of Clarity
low.message: Your responses suggest you may be experiencing minimal emotional strain at this time. This is a positive sign, but remember that self-care and emotional awareness are ongoing practices worth nurturing.
recommendations: Read: 5 Morning Rituals for a Centered Day

moderate.title: A Time for Gentle Attention
moderate.message: Your responses suggest you may be experiencing some emotional strain. This is not uncommon, and acknowledging how you feel is an important first step. Consider exploring supportive resources and speaking with someone you trust.
recommendations: Try our Evening Wind Down audio reflection
Read: The Art of Letting Go
Consider speaking with a mental health professional

high.title: You Deserve Support
high.message: Your responses suggest you may be going through a particularly challenging time emotionally. Please know that you're not alone, and seeking support is a sign of strength, not weakness. We encourage you to reach out to a mental health professional who can provide personalized guidance.
recommendations: Reach out to a trusted friend or family member
Consider speaking with a mental health professional
Practice small acts of self-kindness each day

tools.title: GAD-7: A Gentle Check-In for Anxiety
tools.description: A short self-reflection tool to help you notice how often anxiety-related feelings and thoughts have been showing up in your life.
tools.disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis. It is a screening and reflection tool. If your results feel concerning, or if you are struggling to cope, consider reaching out to a mental health professional.

tools.title: PSS — Perceived Stress Scale
tools.description: A reflective tool to help you notice how stressful life has felt recently. Understand your stress patterns over the last month.
tools.disclaimer: This is not a diagnosis. It is a reflective tool for self-awareness. If stress feels overwhelming, consider reaching out to a mental health professional.

tools.title: Stress Inventory
tools.description: Evaluate your current stress levels and discover personalized strategies for managing and reducing daily pressures.
tools.disclaimer: This assessment provides general guidance and is not a clinical evaluation. If you're experiencing significant stress, please consult a healthcare professional.

questions.question: How often do you feel overwhelmed by your responsibilities?
How well are you able to relax when you have free time?
How often do physical symptoms of stress affect you (headaches, muscle tension, etc.)?
How confident do you feel in handling unexpected problems?
How often do you make time for activities you enjoy?

low.title: High Stress Levels
low.message: Your responses indicate you may be experiencing significant stress. It's important to prioritize stress management and consider seeking support.
recommendations: Read: Mindful Breathing Techniques for Anxiety

moderate.title: Moderate Stress
moderate.message: You're managing but could benefit from additional stress-reduction strategies. Small changes can make a big difference.

high.title: Well-Managed Stress
high.message: You're handling stress effectively. Continue your healthy practices and stay mindful of maintaining balance.

tools.title: Balance Check
tools.description: Assess the harmony between different areas of your life and find opportunities for creating better equilibrium.
tools.disclaimer: This tool helps identify areas for growth and is not a clinical assessment. For personalized guidance, consider consulting a life coach or therapist.

questions.question: How satisfied are you with your work-life balance?
How much time do you dedicate to your physical health?
How fulfilled do you feel in your relationships?
How often do you engage in personal growth activities?
How aligned do your daily activities feel with your values?

low.title: Seeking Balance
low.message: Your life may feel out of balance in several areas. Start by identifying one area to focus on and make small, sustainable changes.

moderate.title: Growing Balance
moderate.message: You're making progress toward balance. Continue nurturing the areas that are working and gently address those that need attention.

high.title: Living in Balance
high.message: You've created meaningful harmony across life areas. Your practices are serving you well—continue to nurture and refine them.
